Name: Pau's Rose Gold Cursors
Author: suzukiPC
Description:
I was working on a site and made a cursor for it, and then I figured, "Hey, why not make something like this for Stardew?" and now we're here :D

[img]https://file.garden/ZgeIGUDRARPwyXAZ/Nexus%20Scrolls/how-to-install2.png[/img]
[color=#444444][size=1]How to install﻿[/size][/color]
1) Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
2) Download the file and unzip it; extract it into your Mods folder

[img]https://file.garden/ZgeIGUDRARPwyXAZ/Nexus%20Scrolls/features.png[/img]﻿
[color=#444444][size=1]Features[/size][/color]
1) Changes the cursors to something more rose gold! There's two versions of it, Sparkly and Not Sparkly.
2) You can set what you like with[b] Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] :)
